programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: .22 Caliber Killer : In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Terror In Disguise : Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Crazy Don : To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Paradise : It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Driven to Kill : A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Crime Spree : They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Killing Spree : In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death In The Delta : When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Takeover : Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Firefight : In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Cracking The Cartel : A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dishonored : Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Melissa Brannen: Missing : In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Fateful Crossing : When the victim of a violent crime is a member of law enforcement, the job of investigating becomes personal. At a United States border crossing, armed fugitives kidnapped a customs' inspector then vanished.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped : On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Moving Target : When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Cruel Revenge : A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Price of Murder : Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Remnant of Blame : The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Out Of The Grave : New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Natural Witness : The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Stolen Identity : When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A Taste of Poison : Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Betrayed : Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Trial Of The Century : Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Dosage : Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Shreds of Evidence : Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Invisible Death : Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Murder By Numbers : For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Obsessions : Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Scent Of The Kill : A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Dead In The Water : Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Electronic Witness : George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: True Crime : They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.desc: Occupations : All of our friends are pretending to be different occupations. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to be. We help Steve, who is pretending to be a reporter, figure out what occupations our various friends are.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Anatomy : Steve discovers his heartbeat with a stethoscope -- and Blue has discovered something too. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue has discovered.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Pool Party : Oh no! It's a hot summer day and Blue and Steve are composing a list of friends to invite to our pool party, but there's someone we forgot to invite! We play Blue's Clues to figure out who's missing from our list.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Nature : We spend the entire episode outdoors enjoying nature and playing Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to play. We identify herbs and help Mr. Salt and Paprika put together a bouquet, go on a walk, and play "I Spy."

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Inventions : We're playing Blues Clues because we want to know what Blue invented. Steve wants to invent something, too, but he keeps inventing things that already exist!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's So Funny? : Something kind of silly's going on at Steve and Blue's house and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what makes Blue laugh.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Environments : Steve and Blue are going on a big trip! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. As we search for clues, we pack for our trip and learn about new environments.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Big Costume Party : It's Blue's costume party and lots of silly spooky things are happening! Magenta doesn't have a costume, so we play Blue's Clues to help her figure out what to wear.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Big Pajama Party : It's a special nighttime game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do tonight. As we search for clues we join Shovel and Pail for a game and learn about the animals who are awake while we are asleep.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Shy : Blue is feeling shy, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what she is feeling shy about. Along the way, we meet Pail's friend Sifter and Miranda, who lives with Magenta. We help Shovel figure out how to play with Sifter.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Magenta Gets Glasses : Magenta Gets Glasses: It's a big day -- Magenta is getting glasses! We launch into a game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Magenta will be able to do when she gets her glasses.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Noël au Canada : Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les armes, c'est rigolo : Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Génial-O : Cartman s'habille comme un robot, s'auto-proclame 'Génial-O' et déménage chez Butters pour découvrir tous ses secrets et les utiliser contre lui.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Jefferson : Une nouvelle famille arrive à South Park : les Jefferson. Monsieur Jefferson accueille les enfants de South Park chez lui pour les faire jouer dans son parc personnel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca : La SPA manifeste contre l'utilisation d'une vache comme mascotte de l'école élémentaire de South Park. Les écoliers sont obligés d'en choisir une autre.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Supermarché des Ténèbres : La rue principale de South Park se transforme en ville fantôme quand un supermarché géant Wall Mart attire les citadins jusqu'à son tout nouveau magasin aux affaires incroyables.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Maternelle : Cela fait cinq ans que Trent Boyett est en prison. Celui-ci y est incarcéré, à la place des garçons, pour avoir brûlé leur professeur de maternelle. Quand il sort de prison, les enfants paniquent alors à l'idée de sa vengeance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Course à l'audience : Les garçons de South Park produisent leur propre journal d'informations du matin sur la station de télévision de l'école, et sont immédiatement entraînés dans une intense course à l'audience.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kit vidéo pour stupide pute trop gâtée : Paris Hilton ouvre une boutique en ville, dans laquelle toutes les petites filles pourront acheter de quoi se transformer en parfaite peste. Son chien s'étant suicidé, Paris veut acheter Butters pour le remplacer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le don incroyable de Cartman : Après avoir reçu une sévère blessure à la tête, Cartman se voit doté de dons de voyance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Noël des petits animaux de la forêt : Stan est sollicité par un groupe d'adorables animaux de la forêt pour les aider à construire une crèche pour la naissance de leur Seigneur et sauveur. Il accepte, mais découvre qu'ils servent en fait Satan.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Vagin tout neuf de M. Garrison : Monsieur Garrison subit une opération de changement de sexe, mais il se rend compte qu'il ne pourra jamais connaître les plaisirs d'avoir ses règles ou l'avortement.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Crève hippie, crève : La ville de South Park est envahie par les hippies qui veulent faire un festival. Leur ennemi juré, Cartman, compte bien les arrêter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Wing : Stan, Kyle, Cartman et Kenny décident de devenir imprésarios. Après l'échec de leur travail avec Token, on leur confie Wing, la femme du gérant de City Wok.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Potes pour la vie : Kenny obtient une PSP, mais il meurt. En réalité, Dieu l'a choisi pour mener une lutte salutaire au paradis. Malheureusement, les docteurs réaniment Kenny, qui se retrouve dans un état végétatif.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La fureur de perdre : Les enfants de South Park sont désespérés : leurs parents veulent absolument qu'ils jouent au baseball mais eux s'ennuient terriblement. Tout empire lorsqu'ils apprennent qu'un match de qualification les obligerait à jouer tout l'été.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Mort d'Eric Cartman : Les enfants se mettent d'accord pour ignorer Cartman, et ce dernier croit qu'il est mort. Butters, qui n'est pas au courant de la supercherie, devient le médium de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le jour des érections : Jimmy a des problèmes d'érections impromptues. Étant donné qu'il doit participer au concours de talents, il cherche de l'aide pour résoudre ce problème.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Marjorine : Butters maquille sa mort pour que les garçons puissent récupérer un appareil à faire des prédictions.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Suivez cet œuf : Madame Garrison a encore des sentiments pour Monsieur Esclave, mais en allant le voir elle s'aperçoit qu'il est avec Al Super Gay et qu'ils comptent se marier.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Rouquins : Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Piégé dans le placard : Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Sauvez Wilzy-X : Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Bloody Mary : Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Retour de Chef : Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Danger Snobfog : Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un million de petites fibres : Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Homoursporc : Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tsst! : La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Make Love, Not Warcraft : Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir : Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Maitresse de Ike : C'est au tour de Cartman d'être le surveillant des couloirs, il profite de l'autorité qui lui est confié pour faire régner l'ordre sévèrement. Pendant ce temps, Ike tombe amoureux de sa maîtresse et ils ont une relation ensemble.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Enfer sur Terre : Satan organise une énorme fête pour petite gamine pourrie gâtée pendant que les enfants de South Park tentent d'invoquer le rappeur Biggie Small en prononçant trois fois son nom devant un miroir.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Election/Francine Goes To War : There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sleep No More/Pet Peeved : Buster is convinced that Pizza Paula's all-you-can-eat contest is his destiny. But how can he possibly win such an important contest without any sleep? Binky volunteers to look after Francine's cat, Nemo, for the weekend.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau : When Mary Moo Cow is cancelled, D.W. is devastated. How can television--or life as she knows it--ever be the same? Buster hasn't yet met Bitzi's new boyfriend, but he fears the worst. What if he is a Mom-stealer?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies : The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy's Soccer Shocker/Brother, Can You Spare A Clarinet? : Muffy's proud that her dad is the new soccer coach--until he exhausts the team with demanding drills. The try-outs for the Young Person's Orchestra are coming to Lakewood Elementary and everyone agrees that Binky is a shoe-in.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos : Buster is convinced that he's seen real UFO's, and he uses Muffy's fancy new telescope to get the proof. Then, Mr. Sipple from next door is moving away and Arthur wonders--who will be the new neighbors?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Citizen Frensky/D.W.'S Backpack Mishap : After visiting The Elwood City Times, Francine decides to start her own paper--The Frensky Star! The tabloid is a success--until all her friends stop speaking to her. Somebody stole D.W.'s backpack!! Who is this fluffy unicorn thief?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Boy With His Head In The Clouds/More! : All the kids know that George is smart--so why does he sometimes have trouble reading and writing? Then, D.W. is thrilled to be getting an allowance. At last, she'll be rich and powerful!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Rhyme For Your Life/For Whom The Bell Tolls : While struggling to write a poem for his mom, Binky falls asleep and gets trapped in Verseberg--where it's a crime not to rhyme! And D.W. has lost her voice! For Arthur it's a dream come true--until Mom asks Arthur to take care of D.W.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Good Sport/Crushed : When the Athlete of the Year Award doesn't go to Francine, she makes no effort to hide her hurt feelings from the recipient. Arthur can't believe his parents are hiring a babysitter--he's 8 years old, and babysitters are b-o-r-i-n-g!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Loses His Marbles/Friday The 13th : When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Cast Away/The Great Sock Mystery : Arthur is thrilled when Dad invites him to go fly-fishing for the weekend. But a change in plans forces them to include D.W. Find out once and for all where socks disappear to when Baby Kate and Pal team up to solve the great sock mystery.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine's Split Decision/Muffy Goes Metropolitan : Lakewood Elementary is sure to win the big bowling tournament on Saturday, but Francine's cousin is having his Bar Mitzvah at the same time! Muffy happily accepts an invitation to spend the weekend in the bustling Crown City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Ants in Arthur's Pants/Don't Ask Muffy : To excel in science, the class has to prove that they have P.A.N.T.S.--the ability to be patient, attentive, nosy, thoughtful, and systematic. And Muffy starts an advice column to launch her career as a rich and famous talk-show host.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: To Tibble the Truth/Waiting to Go : When the Tibble Twins' constant lying lands them in constant trouble, they promise to tell only the truth. Binky and Brain collide on the soccer field, breaking Brain's new watch and nearly breaking their friendship.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Elwood City Turns 100! : Arthur and his friends commemorate their 100th episode in style! Mr. Ratburn's class is chosen to stage a musical tribute to Elwood City for its centennial celebration, which quickly becomes a drama behind the curtain!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Pick a Car, Any Car/Jenna's Bedtime Blues : The family car is broken, and so is Arthur's heart. How can Mom and Dad even think of replacing it? It’s Muffy's annual slumber party, and Jenna is finally invited! But what if the other girls discover that she's an occasional bed-wetter?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s Time Trouble/Buster's Amish Mismatch : D.W. is tired of being bossed around all the time and demands to know why she couldn't have been born before Arthur! And during a trip to Amish country, Buster becomes enamored with the simple life and vows to forgo modern conveniences.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The World of Tomorrow/Is There a Doctor in the House? : Since Binky's repeating third grade, he's totally dreading Mr. Ratburn's annual class sleepover at the Science Museum. Arthur and D.W. face the ultimate challenge when Mom gets a bad cold and then gives it to Dad!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Prunella Sees the Light/Return of the Snowball : For her sleepover with Marina, Prunella redecorates her room. But Marina is blind--will the decorations she can't see offend her, or worse, make her trip? D.W. has been trying to solve the mystery of her snowball's disappearance.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: April 9th : April 9th is a normal day until a fire destroys the teacher's lounge and forces Lakewood Elementary to close. This unexpected event finds creates a wide range of emotional reactions, for Arthur, his friends and teachers, and the community.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Dear Adil/Bitzi's Break-Up : Arthur is worried that his letters to his new Turkish pen pal, Adil, will be boring. After all, how can Elwood City compare to Arthur's fantastical ideas about Turkey? Bitzi is breaking up with her boyfriend, and Buster is really sad.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Fernfern and the Secret of Moose Mountain/Thanks a Lot, Binky : Fern can't wait to climb Moose Mountain so that she can have adventures like Zutzut, the famous comic-book hero! Then, Binky decides to become "No More Mr. Nice Guy" after not getting thanked for saving Rattles from a dangerous stunt.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Snow Biz/Bugged : Winter hits Elwood City and Arthur sees dollar signs! His snow-shoveling business is booming--that is, until Buster decides to get in on the action. And, Brain can be a know-it-all, and sometimes he really bugs people.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Fernkenstein's Monster/D.W., Dancing Queen : Inspired by Mary Shelley's "Frankenstein," Fern tells a tale so scary that Arthur and the gang become afraid of her! Then, Binky decides to teach D.W. to dance, but she just doesn't seem to get the moves. Is D.W. a no-talent klutz?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Vomitrocious!/Sue Ellen Chickens Out : It's just a regular day until Francine starts to feel queasy, and then throws up in the cafeteria! Now Francine is afraid to go back to school. And, Sue Ellen learns that a fast-food chain is taking over the beloved Sugar Bowl.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Postcards from Buster, Parts I & II : Buster's going to New York City to meet his dad Bo, and the Reads are coming with him! He's thrilled ... but won't his mom miss him? But, Bitzi gives him a present that will let him share his exciting trip with her--a video camera!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Desk Wars/Desperately Seeking Stanley : When Mr. Ratburn moves Brain and Arthur away from their usual desks, it sets off a chain reaction resulting in the most explosive desk war in third grade history! And, Arthur is 8-years old now—does he still need his teddy bear?

programme.desc: Moving America : To see how people, products, and more move around America, Adam Richman explores how a legendary long-hauler meticulously custom-builds each truck at Daimler.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Bulletproof : Experts design materials that can catch gunfire.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Edison Tech : Thomas Alva Edison, the Wizard of Menlo Park, created electric lights, power systems, motion pictures, recorded sound, and tattoo pens; his innovations evolved into modern CDs, iPods, satellite radio, and technologies from Internet to outer space.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Swamp Tech : The assembly and surprising history behind the airboat; a wild ride on a big-tired swamp buggy; local delicacies that bring new meaning to acquired taste; a massive engineering project to divert the mighty Mississippi River; pythons and alligators.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Whiskey : Tours of some of the world's finest whiskey distilleries demonstrate how different countries put their unique stamps on an ancient drink called the "water of life"; Jack Daniels; Jim Beam; Canadian Club; Jameson's; Glenlivet.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Alaska : From brutal winters to bug-infested summers, survival in the unforgiving landscape of Alaska requires an array of technological innovations and creative solutions.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Wine : Wine remains culturally integral as Napoleon drowned sorrows and Jefferson became obsessed; modern consumption peaks with wines from Australia, Chile, South Africa using NASA aerial imaging technology for soil analysis and vine vigor assessment.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Amazing Gadgets Countdown : A countdown of the top gizmos and gadgets featured on "Modern Marvels," from golden oldies to newfangled thingamabobs, including an electronic doodad that was once considered a threat to national security.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: James Bond Gadgets : His movies are legend, his women beautiful, and his toys the best in the world; James Bond is foiling villains in space-age flying machines or eavesdropping on his enemies with ultra-sophisticated spy gear.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The F-14 : The U.S. Navy's most lethal fighter, the F-14, soars at supersonic speeds.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Canning : It's the unsung essential of modern life; canning is the method of preserving and packaging food, without which civilization would never have ventured beyond the local food supply.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Corn : Corn is the largest agricultural crop in the world, and it is used in more than 3,000 diverse items, ranging from food to the plastic wrap for packaging it.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Milk : Around the world, people consume billions of gallons of milk every day; a cow-milking parlor; pasteurization; a three-story milk evaporator; milking a yak; the world's largest butter churn; yogurt.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Engineering Disasters of the '70s : The sinking of the Edmund Fitzgerald; the Buffalo Creek Dam disaster; the explosion of a supertanker in Los Angeles Harbor.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Engineering Disasters 22 : From a massive oil spill to refinery blaze to a downed plane, find out what went wrong and how to prevent the next engineering disaster.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Aqueducts: Man Made Rivers of Life : Many rivers quenched the thirst of millions in the American west and around the world; without these aqueducts, some of the earth's largest cities would turn into gigantic ghost towns.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Made in the USA : The world's biggest and oldest flag manufacturer; inside the last US athletic shoe factory; the strangest form of alternate transportation; a hot toy company that believes it's imperative to keep their work here at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview : Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Finding Allene & Mollie Pt. 3 : The tense family drama continues. Dr. Phil sent Private Investigator Harold Copus thousands of miles through three countries including the jungles of Belize to find two sisters, Allene and Mollie, who were abducted by their father one year ago. Part 3

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Honeymoon Hangover : Are you newlyweds suffering Honeymoon Hangover? The Bahamas vacation is over, the dress is put away and couples realize they now have this to face: Married Life. Dr. Phil discovers how little couples know about each other before they walk down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Falsely Accused Mothers? : Stacy and her boyfriend are accused of burning her 3-year-old daughter with cigarettes. What will lie detector tests reveal? Plus, Christina's mother has called CPS on her four times for allegedly abusing her grandson. Are Christina's kids in danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Most Outrageous Monster-In-Law Returns : The Monster-In-Law is back! Khalood confessed to calling her son-in-law, Steve, a "loser" and "dumbass" and lacing his drink with a laxative! Does she still say Steve is incapable of supporting a family? Hear what Steve’s mom has to say about the feud!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Banned From The Wedding : A bride-to-be takes on her future mother-in-law in an ugly feud that has torn a family apart. Can Dr. Phil cut through the drama and broker some peace for this family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Absentee Mom, Clueless Dad : John says his ex-wife, Laurie, abandoned their children. John admits his boys disrespect his authority, with one son punching him in the face. As Laurie denies deserting her children, we hear from the three boys: is it clueless parenting or unruly kids?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Honeymoon's Over : Do couples give up too easily on marriage? More newlyweds, married only a few months, are pulling off their wedding bands and calling it quits. Dr. Phil's guests haven't even been married a year, and are already wondering if they made the right decision.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trapped : When you and your beloved say "I do," it's "for better or worse." But what happens when all you feel is the "worse" part and wind up trapped in a bad marriage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For Better Or Worse : Some couples vow "for better or worse." With a 50% divorce rate in America, in the midst of marital crises ranging from separation to unfaithfulness, Dr. Phil helps manage rocky marriages. Dr.Phil tells how to survive infidelity or when to call it quits.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Deadbeat Dad? : Katlynn, Zach & Amber say dad Todd prioritizes everything over them: job, wife & new family. They say their dad missed weekend visits, failed to pay child support & even wrote a letter denouncing his parental rights. Could Todd do more or just a bad rap?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000 : An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marriage Crisis: Drowning In Debt : Money is the number one reason why couples say they get divorced. The country's current financial crisis has resulted in more couples getting buried in a landslide of debt which takes its toll on a marriage. Is your marriage on the rocks because of debt?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From Tech-Genius To Unmotivated Mess : Logan, 30, desperately needs help. Mom Tracy says he has gone from a productive computer science engineer to a shell of a human being: no motivation, rarely eats, & can barely function to take care of his basic hygiene needs. Can Logan get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dirt, Lies And The Internet : Dr. Phil investigates a popular new website that dishes the dirt on non-celebrities. On creator Nik Richie's controversial site, TheDirty.com, people anonymously submit photos & negative comments about anyone in their community, tabloid style.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Save My Beautiful Daughters From Their Narcissistic Father : Mom Jessica says husband Mike is a controlling narcissist. Chloe, 16, & Zoey, 18, say dad shattered their dancing dreams. Mike says Jessica puts the girls in the middle. Dr. Phil tells mom & dad what couples need to do with children as a marriage ends.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marriage On Hiatus : After 21 years, Paula is considering divorcing husband, Jeremy, saying he's "clueless, absent & non-verbal." Jeremy says it's Paula--controlling & a grudge-holder. Find out Jeremy's mistake. Dr. Phil and Robin share the secret to their 45-year marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Wifestyles : What makes a good wife? Is it cooking, cleaning, raising the kids and having great sex? Dr. Phil says too few couples understand what it means to be a "Mrs." He delves into the role of the wife in 2005.

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest
programme.desc: One Trick Phony : Hearing of a nearby amusement park for battling, Ash is eager to test his skills. But the Team Rocket trio have recently joined the park, and they have a few ideas in store to test this Trainer's mettle!

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Pokemon: Master Quest

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: Minutes to Live : An unconscious woman is bleeding internally. Doctors must quickly assess the problem, and convince a reluctant surgeon to take the case. A man with a 4-day erection needs extraordinary help. A woman arrives in the ER with a knife in her chest.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.title: Counting Cars

programme.title: Counting Cars

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Vantastic Voyage : When Counts Kustom's master painter Ryan decides to paint his own van, the entire crew buckles in for a bumpy ride. Will cooperation and a little spite help Ryan turn his ugly truck into the ultimate 70s street machine?

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Smokin Hot Corvette : Danny and the Count's Kustom Crew kick into overdrive, transforming a 25th Anniversary 1978 Corvette Pace Car into a high octane street demon.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: A Bumpy Ride : Bill needs Dan to tame a 1969 Pontiac Firebird that was set-up for just one thing – speed. Tim’s 1974 International Harvester Scout was given a paint job that took 4 years. He hopes that Dan can somehow pick up the pieces. Literally.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mismatching Numbers : Steve has only driven his prized 1969 Camaro Z28 at five miles an hour, but he wants it to be a muscle car beast. Scott owns a rare matching numbers 1964 Corvette that he wants brought back to life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Another Bricklin The Wall : Walter loves the fast and futuristic look of his 1975 Bricklin. Unfortunately, the car drives like something from the dark ages. Dan restores a 1963 Split Window Corvette for a pair of owners who know him well – his Uncle Carl and Aunt Claire.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tri Power Trials : Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Snake Bite : FantomWorks dull the fangs on a 1965 Shelby Cobra kit car and bring a 1964 Dodge Dart back on target.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Chevy Shock : Patsy and Apryle bring their 1968 Corvette in for mechanical work, but what their car really needs is a new paint job. Jim’s 1958 Impala is an auction car. It looks pretty but when it’s time to drive – it’s half the car Jim was hoping for.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Flathead 'Til I'm Dead : Chris wants the 1950 F1 Truck he remembers from high school and Dean wants the 1968 Lincoln Continental he drove with his dad.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kit Car Chaos : Bob spent years working on his beloved 1969 K20 Truck, but he needs FantomWorks to solve the mysteries within. Dan’s brother-in-law John shows up with a 1962 Ferrari kit car that looks hot, but the wiring could burn it to the ground.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Busted Knuckle : Kim and Doug want to drive her father’s hyper-rare 1959 Thunderbolt, but the car was only set up for the racetrack. Batalla is a legendary motorcycle builder who asks Dan to restore his prized possession - a 1947 Knucklehead.

programme.desc: Death Breath : An ER nurse brings her delirious husband to the ER, then notices that his breath smells like mothballs. A young mother delivers her baby, then goes into life-threatening convulsions. Identical twin doctors create hilarious confusion in the ER.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Ordinary Hero : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) find themselves in a jam when the witness in an assault case turns out to be an illegal alien who is about to be deported. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: The Psychic : A psychic's (guest star Elizabeth Ashley) predictions provide Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) with their only leads when a missing person's case turns into a murder investigation. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: The Lottery : Cagney and Lacey are brought in when a lottery jackpot is being claimed by multiple people. They must decide who has the real ticket and whose winning ticket is actually counterfeit. Meanwhile, Lacey and Harvey prepare for an IRS audit.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Entrapment : During an underground investigation of a notorious narcotics dealer, Cagney crosses the line to entrapment and expects Lacey to commit perjury on her behalf. Lacey must then decide if she stands by her partner or admit to knowing nothing about it.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: The Clinic : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey's (Tyne Daly) investigation of the fire-bombing of an abortion clinic places them on opposing sides over this controversial issue. When a patient is killed in the blast, they must decide if it was one murder or two.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Mothers And Sons : The detective must crack a mother's testimony on the alibi of her son who is accused of robbery and assault while Lacey (Tyne Daly) must deal with her own son's problems at school. Also starring Sharon Gless as Christine Cagney.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Filial Duty : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the robbery and murder of a 70-year-old recluse as Charlie Cagney (guest star Dick O'Neill) is hospitalized with pneumonia. Meanwhile, a pregnant Lacey must learn to adapt her work routine.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Old Ghosts : Cagney is branded as a coward after a robbery suspect is able to elude her during a chase. She is suspended from duty, leaving Lacey to clear her name. Meanwhile, Cagney's brother Brian visits from California and checks in on their father.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Power : When Cagney is placed in charge of the 14th Precinct during Lt. Samuels' vacation, her fellow detectives accuse her of being on a power trip. Meanwhile she is disappointed that one of her first assignments is to force Lacey to go on maternity leave.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Play It Again, Santa : Cagney (Sharon Gless) goes undercover with Det. Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) to investigate a series of disappearing Santa Clauses and issues with music rights. Also starring Tyne Daly as Mary Beth Lacey and Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: The Rapist : When Lacey goes out on maternity leave, Cagney's is given a temporary partner temporary partner, Sara Jones. Jones becomes obsessed with a rape investigation and increasingly frustrated with the length of time it is taking to arrest the suspect.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Act Of Conscience : While Lacey is on maternity leave, Cagney is assigned a controversial new partner who's past of turning in other cops who have participated in illegal activity makes the rest of the 14th precinct question how long he will stay among them.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: D.W.I. : While Lacey is on maternity leave, she becomes involved in investigating a neighborhood hit-and-run accident. Meanwhile, Cagney is forced to face her relationship to alcohol after a DWI case comes in while she is working the late shift.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: The Gimp : While investigating a series of muggings of disabled persons, Cagney (Sharon Gless) gets a first-hand look at the problems they face and becomes romantically involved with a man (guest star James Stacy) who is handicapped and advocating for change.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Family Connections : Cagney has to rush to Lacey's side at the hospital, hoping that she can make it before the baby is delivered. Being around Lacey and her family makes Cagney have second thoughts about her life as a singleton. Cagney's father has a new girlfriend.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Post Partum : Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes involved in a case where a West Point cadet is charged with possession of cocaine and is refusing to help himself due to his honor code. Meanwhile, Lacey's (Tyne Daly) father pays her a visit after a 30-year absence.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: The Man Who Shot Trotsky : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) receive a second opportunity to nail a notorious narcotics dealer as Petrie (Carl Lumbly) and Isbecki (Martin Kove) go 'off-Broadway' to pursue a murder case. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.
